defective_pattern: Editing .md and .docx asymmetrically instead of compiling .docx strictly from .md source of truth
why_defective: Breaks the Triad Invariant and introduces data divergence where the JSON/MD representations do not match the final DOCX, leading to audit failure.
observed_symptoms: Manual patches applied to DOCX only
MD and DOCX files out of sync
Missing data in MD while present in DOCX
corrective_remedy: Always edit the MD source of truth and compile the DOCX deterministically from it to ensure the Triad Invariant is strictly upheld.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Comparison heuristic detecting drift between MD and DOCX
